name: Write-a-Review Form
summary: Native review-form composition that delegates rating and field semantics to Star Input, Input, Textarea, File Upload, Select, and Button.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native form boundary that owns layout and emits a submit request without defining transport or workflow.

anatomy.name: fields
anatomy.description: Optional structural group for composed form fields.

anatomy.name: group
anatomy.description: Optional layout wrapper; it does not own labels, controls, messages, or validation.

anatomy.name: rating
anatomy.description: Composed Star Input that owns the native rating question and radio behavior.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Optional composed Input that owns its label, value, message, validation variant, focus, and disabled state.

anatomy.name: textarea
anatomy.description: Composed Textarea field that retains Input validation composition and multi-line behavior.

anatomy.name: fileUpload
anatomy.description: Optional composed File Upload that owns native file input, constraints, feedback, and selected-file presentation.

anatomy.name: select
anatomy.description: Optional composed Select that owns its native fallback, enhancement, options, and validation state.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Wrapping action region for the form controls.

anatomy.name: submitButton
anatomy.description: Composed Button rendered as the native submit action; Button owns disabled and busy presentation.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned response region; presence does not define when or how submission feedback appears.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional accessible name for the native form when a surrounding heading does not already label it.

properties.name: rating
properties.description: Required Star Input composition; its label, name, value, required, disabled, and describedBy properties remain owned by Star Input.

properties.name: textField
properties.description: Optional Input composition, such as a review title; Input retains all value-entry and validation semantics.

properties.name: reviewBody
properties.description: Required Textarea composition; Textarea and Input retain label, value, line bounds, resize, message, and validation ownership.

properties.name: photoUpload
properties.description: Optional File Upload composition; file constraints, selection feedback, validation, and removal remain owned by File Upload and the target.

properties.name: classification
properties.description: Optional Select composition whose option inventory and meaning are target-owned.

properties.name: submitAction
properties.description: Required native submit Button composition; Button retains label, variant, disabled, busy, icon, and loading semantics.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Optional target-owned submission feedback or status region without a prescribed workflow.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Contained form with a maximum inline size of 600px.

states.name: default
states.description: Structural form state; composed controls expose their own interaction and validation states.

behavior.name: nativeSubmitRequest
behavior.description: The native form emits a submit request after browser and composed-control validation. Endpoint, authentication, pending state, errors, success, moderation, and reset behavior remain target-owned.

behavior.name: valueEntryComposition
behavior.description: Input, Textarea, and Select retain their canonical labels, messages, Default, Error, Success, Warning, hover, focus-visible, disabled, and native-value obligations; Review Form does not duplicate them.

behavior.name: fileComposition
behavior.description: File Upload retains native file selection, constraints, validation, and selected-file feedback. Review Form does not infer file policy or upload transport.

behavior.name: buttonComposition
behavior.description: Button retains native submit, disabled, busy, focus-visible, and loading-indicator behavior; Review Form does not create a parallel submit-button state model.

behavior.name: stateOwnership
behavior.description: Static Web preserves child-native initial values, reset, and FormData. Framework targets may control one value per child or use child defaults, but must not keep a second Review Form copy of child state.

accessibility: Use a native form and preserve each composed control's native label, name, value, validation, reset, and submission behavior.
Do not replace Input, Textarea, File Upload, Select, Star Input, or Button validation and focus semantics with Review Form selectors.
Associate target-owned feedback with the relevant composed control and use live-region behavior only when the target workflow requires it.
Keep validation errors available before and after submission without moving focus unless the target deliberately implements an error-summary pattern.
Button busy state must prevent duplicate activation while preserving its accessible name.

web.notes: Canonical CSS owns only responsive form layout and containment; composed components retain visual and validation ownership.

shopify.notes: A future adapter must select a review provider, form endpoint, file policy, and submission workflow.
